## Dependency Graph

```
SPRINT-001 (MVP Auth + Persistence)
    ├─→ SPRINT-002 (AI Advisor)        [needs: backend scaffold, auth, assessments table]
    └─→ SPRINT-003 (Billing)           [needs: backend scaffold, auth, assessments table]
            ↑
        SPRINT-002 (AI Advisor)        [needs: AI endpoints to enforce pro tier on]
```

SPRINT-002 and SPRINT-003 can be worked on in parallel ONLY AFTER SPRINT-001 is merged.
SPRINT-003 should be built after SPRINT-002 because it needs to gate AI advisor endpoints.

**Strict sequence required:**
1. SPRINT-001 — must merge first (creates the entire backend + DB layer)
2. SPRINT-002 — build after SPRINT-001 merges (adds AI layer)
3. SPRINT-003 — build after SPRINT-002 merges (adds billing + gating on AI)

## How to Build

### Recommended — One sprint at a time, in order (Wasp autopilot)

SPRINT-001 must complete and merge before starting SPRINT-002.
SPRINT-002 must complete and merge before starting SPRINT-003.

**Sprint 1 — MVP Auth + Persistence**
```
Use autopilot-wasp. Build from sprint spec docs/specs/SPRINT-001-saas-mvp-auth-persistence.md

**Sprint 2 — AI Advisor (after Sprint 1 is merged)**
```
Use autopilot-wasp. Build from sprint spec docs/specs/SPRINT-002-ai-advisor-streaming.md
```

**Sprint 3 — Billing (after Sprint 2 is merged)**
```

## Pre-Build Checklist

Before running Sprint 1, complete these manually:

- [ ] Create a new Supabase project at supabase.com (free tier is sufficient for pre-launch)
- [ ] Copy project URL and anon key to `backend/.env`
- [ ] Create a Railway account and link the repo
- [ ] Create a Vercel account and link the repo root for frontend deployment
- [ ] Create a Stripe account (test mode is fine for SPRINT-003)
- [ ] Set `window.ADVISOR_API_URL` in `index.html` to the Railway backend URL before deploying frontend

---

## Post-Sprint 1 Deployment Notes

**Frontend (Vercel):**
- Deploy repo root — Vercel serves `index.html` directly
- Set environment variable: `ADVISOR_API_URL` is set via `window.ADVISOR_API_URL` in a `<script>` tag added to `index.html` — hardcode the Railway URL after first deployment

**Backend (Railway):**
- Root directory: `backend/`
- Start command: `uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`
- Set all env vars from `backend/.env.example` in Railway dashboard

**Supabase:**
- Run migrations: `supabase db push` from repo root (requires Supabase CLI)
- Enable email confirmation in Auth settings for production; disable for development
